### The Great Works of God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/great-works-god
Passage: Psalm 111:1-10
Points:
- God's works in creation display His power and character, leading believers to praise Him.
- His works of redemption show His enduring mercy and covenant faithfulness toward His people.
- Israel's history demonstrates that true wisdom begins with reverence for the Lord.
- Daily meditation on God's mighty deeds keeps believers from forgetfulness and spiritual ruin.

### Psalm 111: Delighting in the Works of God
Author: Joe Rigney
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/psalm-111-delighting-in-the-works-of-god
Passage: Psalm 111:2
Points:
- Genuine delight naturally motivates believers to study and meditate on what they cherish.
- Psalm 111 calls God's people to remember His historical deliverance from Egypt to the Promised Land.
- The recurring emphasis on "forever" points ahead to God's greater works of future redemption.
- Christ fulfills these ancient patterns through His death, resurrection, and the salvation of nations.
